value: Sim chooser stays default and ruler. --rewards value: bulk reads on train-card sequences only (level, 1/6 wall time); never with unseen cards in offers (-4 HP, 2.7 se). Its train-half lead (+4-5 HP) waits for Act 1; then it's the headline chooser per decision/headline-pool-after-act1.

history.value: The sim chooser (--rewards sim --sim-boss) stays the default and the ruler for every read; gauntlet.py play --rewards value (the net's static values of fight start states, no trial fights; level on the headline at a sixth of the wall time, measurement/portfolio-value-chooser) is a tool for bulk reads on train-card sequences only, never on a read whose offers hold cards the net did not train on (there it is 4 HP below the sim chooser at 2.7 se: the novelty cost moves from the fights into the picks). Its lead on the train half (+4 to +5 HP, +0.06 clears, 3-3.7 se, sequences 0-499, one turn deep) is not confirmed or built on now: a chooser change is run-level decision work and waits for Act 1's cards (docs/direction.md, Avoid), which bring a new net and pool. It is the first candidate of the chooser workstream (decision/chooser-workstream): static values where every offered card is a trained card, trial fights where one is not; on today's files that split reads about +2 HP and +0.03 clears overall. Reopen: Act 1's cards in the engine and a net trained on them; confirm on sequences 500-999 at fixed n before building.
